text:
I rented a one-bedroom flat in Puebla from August 2024 and gave notice on the 3rd of May, which is six weeks before the lease ended. My deposit was 9,600 pesos and the landlord, Gerardo Lombana, has only offered back 5,100. He says the early notice cancels my right to a full refund.

My company moved my team to its Monterrey office, and I was told on the 28th of April that I had to relocate by mid-June. The transfer letter from HR is dated that same week, and I never agreed to it voluntarily. I think the lease allows early termination if an employer transfers the tenant, but I have not found the exact clause.

Gerardo also deducted 1,800 pesos for repainting the bedroom. I painted that wall myself in 2024 after he approved the colour by text, and I have the photos from move-in.
task: Draft a letter asking my landlord to return the full deposit, explaining why I left before the lease ended.

text:
I moved out of the apartment in Guadalajara on 14 September, and the landlord, Rosario Quiñones, says she will return the 12,000-peso deposit within thirty days. It is now day forty-one and I have received nothing, not even a message. The lease says the deposit must be returned within thirty days of handing back the keys, and I have the signed key receipt.

The lease was in my name and my former partner, Emiliano Duarte, but we separated in July and he moved out before me. We agreed in writing that whatever comes back is split 60 percent to me and 40 percent to him, because I paid the larger share of the rent. He has not agreed to keep the deposit if the landlord only pays one of us.

My last rent payment of 6,300 pesos went out on 1 September, and the landlord confirmed it by text.

text:
I have a family plan with Selvatel for four lines at 1,020 pesos a month, and I am the account holder. Last month the bill showed 640 pesos of roaming charges on the line used by my daughter Camila, even though she stayed in Querétaro the whole time. I phoned the call centre, and the agent, Ricardo Zambrano, said the charge came from a network test that the company would review within ten business days.

My daughter has lived with her father since June under a custody arrangement agreed in court, and she is staying with him through the end of the school year. I would like her line, the one that carries the 160-peso child-safety add-on, to be moved onto his account without cancelling the number she has had since she was nine. Her father, Santiago, has said he is willing to take over the payments, and he will go to a store with his own ID.

The bill is due on the 20th and I normally pay on the 18th, always from the same debit card.

approved_output: Build 2291 failed on the unit test step. The error is AssertionError: expected 3 retries but got 2 in test_retry_policy. The same test passes on my laptop with Python 3.12 and fails on the CI image, which still uses Python 3.10. I think the retry decorator uses the newer typing syntax, but I have not checked whether the loop count changed too. The pinned versions are pytest 8.2.1 and requests 2.32.3, and nothing else in the lockfile changed this week. I would rather understand the cause than just bump the CI image.
